title: lolium temulentum var. arvense
intro: Lolium temulentum var. arvense, commonly known as false cleaver, is a plant species within the grass family, characterized by its small, inconspicuous flowers and ability to form dense stands in agricultural fields. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues and inflammation, due to its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve overall well-being. Therapeutically, Lolium temulentum var. arvense is thought to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory actions, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of Lolium temulentum var. arvense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its pharmacological properties.
